summary.text: Kellee Hennessy is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 64, which the legislature's member page lists as covering East Baton Rouge and Livingston parishes. First elected in 2023, Kellee Hennessy sits on the Health and Welfare, Judiciary, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page, which lists the member as Kellee Hennessy Dickerson, gives the occupation as television news anchor and reporter and small business owner, with a B.A. in English and journalism.

The House page lists Kellee Hennessy's committee assignments as Health and Welfare, Judiciary, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, House Select Committee on Disaster Recovery, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus (vice chair), Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
